Faster inference can be achieved when multiple draft tokens pass verification simultaneously. Recent parallel draft architectures (DFlash, DSpark) improve draft quality by conditioning on rich features computed by the target, through a mechanism known as feature encoding. However, standard feature encoding mechanisms have three limitations: (1) they are lossy, applying encoding projections that are destructive to the underlying target feature-space via a discovered effect known as residual mixing, (2) they are memory-less, with no record of previously processed proposals, and (3) they utilize features sampled uniformly from across the target layers, omitting important hidden states. To address these issues, we propose Mixture-of-Features Attention (MoFA), a lightweight feature-encoding approach equipped with a working memory that encodes previously rejected proposals. Leveraging MoFA, rejection memory, and a set of further enhancements, including 2-tap causal convolutions, prefix-only cross-attention, and non-uniform target layer selection, the final architecture, DNeo, achieves 1.3x faster generation speed than SoTA (DFlash-2) without impacting drafter footprint or generation quality. DNeo marks a new state of the art in high quality, fast LLM inference.

ru.title: Быстрее генерировать, не теряя качества: память отказов для ускорения LLM
ru.desc: В статье предлагается ускорение инференса большой языковой модели (LLM) за счёт speculative-diffusion декодирования, где маленькая параллельная модель-драфтер предлагает несколько токенов за один проход. Авторы выделяют три недостатка стандартного feature encoding: потерю информации из-за residual mixing, отсутствие памяти о ранее отклонённых предложениях и равномерную выборку скрытых состояний по слоям. Для их решения вводится Mixture-of-Features Attention (MoFA) с рабочей памятью отказов, а также улучшения вроде 2-tap causal convolutions, prefix-only cross-attention и неравномерного выбора слоёв. Итоговая архитектура DNeo даёт прирост скорости генерации в 1.3 раза относительно SoTA без увеличения размера драфтера и потери качества.

en.title: Learn from rejected drafts to speed up LLM generation
en.desc: The paper introduces DNeo, a lightweight draft model that helps large language models generate text faster using speculative-diffusion decoding. Its Mixture-of-Features Attention (MoFA) preserves useful target-model features and uses rejection memory to learn from draft tokens that were rejected. DNeo also adds causal convolutions, prefix-only cross-attention, and a more selective choice of target-model layers. The authors report that it generates text 1.3 times faster than DFlash-2 without increasing draft-model size or reducing generation quality.

zh.title: 记住被拒绝的草稿，让大模型推理提速 1.3 倍
zh.desc: 论文研究如何加快大语言模型的推理，重点是让草稿模型提出的多个 token 能更高效地通过目标模型验证。作者提出轻量级特征编码方法 MoFA，并加入工作记忆，用来保留先前被拒绝的草稿信息。最终架构 DNeo 还结合了因果卷积、仅使用前缀的交叉注意力，以及更有针对性的目标模型层选择。实验显示，DNeo 在不增加草稿模型规模、也不降低生成质量的情况下，比 DFlash-2 快 1.3 倍。

papers.title: HubEgo-100K: In-the-Wild Egocentric Video of Skilled Work for Robot Learning
papers.abstract: Abstract  Robot policies trained by imitation generalize poorly outside the environments and objects seen in training. Published data-scaling studies find that generalization grows with the diversity of training environments and objects rather than with more demonstrations per environment. Robot data is costly to collect across many environments, whereas egocentric human video can be recorded in the wild at scale; existing egocentric video, however, mostly shows daily-life activity and contains little skilled work in real workplaces. We present HubEgo-100K, a dataset built for diversity. This version of the paper covers the first release, v1.0: 10,124 hours of 1080p egocentric video with synchronized 100 Hz inertial (IMU) data from one head-mounted phone camera. In v1.0, 12,227 contributors record their own unscripted work in 15,548 environments (each one contributor's own setting of one type, such as their kitchen or workshop) across 11 setting types, 30 work categories, 56 task types and 35 action families, with 83% of hours in workplace settings. The release comprises 72,754 episodes with machine-generated action and language annotations, in LeRobot and MCAP formats under CC BY 4.0. We measure diversity along each axis, show that inside v1.0, with episodes in random order, new contributors and words keep appearing, and relate the measurements to published evidence on six data properties tied to policy performance, including hand visibility and inertial sensing. We also document collection, curation, privacy measures and data format, and provide a datasheet. Later versions of this paper will add benchmarks and cover further releases toward 100,000 hours.

ru.title: Разнообразие среды важнее количества демонстраций: учим роботов на видео реального труда
ru.desc: Авторы представляют HubEgo-100K — датасет для обучения роботов через имитацию, где главный акцент сделан на разнообразии, а не на количестве демонстраций в одной среде. Первая версия v1.0 содержит 10 124 часа 1080p эгоцентричного видео с синхронизированными IMU-данными на 100 Гц, записанного 12 227 участниками в 15 548 средах. Большая часть записей (83%) сделана на рабочих местах, что восполняет недостаток существующих эгоцентричных датасетов, в основном отражающих повседневную жизнь. Данные выпущены под лицензией CC BY 4.0 в форматах LeRobot и MCAP с автоматически сгенерированными аннотациями действий и языковыми описаниями, а авторы анализируют разнообразие и связывают его с известными свойствами данных, влияющими на качество policy.

en.title: Learn Robot Skills from Work in the Wild
en.desc: Robot imitation policies often struggle in new environments, and prior research suggests that diverse training data helps more than collecting extra demonstrations in the same setting. HubEgo-100K v1.0 provides 10,124 hours of egocentric video with synchronized inertial measurements, recorded by 12,227 people across varied workplaces and other settings. The dataset contains 72,754 episodes with automatically generated action and language annotations, and its authors assess its diversity and relate it to data properties associated with policy performance. It is designed to support research on learning robot policies from large-scale human activity data, with future releases planned to expand it toward 100,000 hours.

zh.title: 汇聚真实工作场景，让机器人从多样化第一人称数据中学习
zh.desc: 机器人模仿学习策略在训练中未见过的环境和物体上，往往难以泛化；已有研究显示，增加环境与物体的多样性比单纯增加示范数量更有帮助。由于在许多真实环境中采集机器人数据成本高，本文推出 HubEgo-100K，利用头戴式手机摄像头收集大规模第一人称工作视频，并同步记录 100 Hz 的惯性测量单元（IMU）数据。首版包含 12,227 名贡献者在 15,548 个环境中录制的 10,124 小时视频，覆盖多种工作场景、任务和动作，并附有机器生成的动作与语言标注。作者分析了数据集的多样性及其与机器人策略性能相关的数据特征，并说明数据采集、隐私保护和格式；后续版本计划扩展至 100,000 小时并加入基准测试。

papers.title: MillBill: A Machining Agent with Geometric Feedback
papers.abstract: Abstract  Turning a CAD model into a machining program requires both process knowledge and geometric precision. Language models can generate such workflows by writing geometry and toolpath code for each part, but this makes numerical execution part of the model's task. We introduce MillBill, an agent that separates machining decisions from their geometric execution and verification. Given a boundary-representation part, stock, and material, a locally hosted, mid-sized open model proposes operations and cutting parameters for indexed three-axis machining. A geometric harness generates toolpaths, simulates material removal, and returns feedback for plan refinement. Setup planning accounts for what the available cutters can physically reach, rather than visibility alone. We evaluate the resulting programs by the fraction of the target surface area within the specified tolerance after simulated machining. With Qwen3.8-27B, MillBill outperforms frontier-model approaches that construct their own geometry and toolpath workflows on the evaluated machining tasks. Code: https://github.com/kulibinai/millbill

ru.title: Пусть LLM решает, как резать, а геометрия пусть считает сама
ru.desc: Статья представляет MillBill — агента, который переводит CAD-модель в программу для станка с ЧПУ, разделяя принятие решений и геометрическое исполнение. Локально развёрнутая открытая LLM среднего размера (Qwen3.8-27B) предлагает операции и режимы резания, а геометрический модуль строит траектории, симулирует снятие материала и возвращает обратную связь для уточнения плана. Планирование установки учитывает физическую достижимость инструментом, а не только видимость поверхностей. По доле поверхности, обработанной в пределах допуска, MillBill превосходит подходы на основе frontier-моделей, которые сами пишут геометрический и траекторный код.

en.title: Let the model plan; let geometry verify
en.desc: MillBill is an agent that turns a CAD part, stock, and material into a machining plan for indexed three-axis machining. A locally hosted language model chooses machining operations and cutting parameters, while a separate geometric harness creates toolpaths and simulates material removal. The harness checks whether cutters can physically reach the required surfaces and gives feedback that helps refine the plan. In tests, MillBill with Qwen3.8-27B achieved better surface accuracy than frontier-model approaches that generated their own geometry and toolpath workflows.

zh.title: 让模型规划加工，让几何工具精准执行与验证
zh.desc: 这篇论文提出了 MillBill，一个用于从 CAD 模型生成加工程序的智能体。它将加工决策与几何计算、刀具路径生成和验证分开：语言模型选择加工工序及切削参数，几何工具负责模拟材料去除并反馈结果，以便不断改进方案。系统规划装夹时会考虑刀具在物理上能否到达加工区域，而不只看几何可见性。实验以加工后符合公差的目标表面面积比例评估程序；使用 Qwen3.8-27B 时，MillBill 在测试任务中优于自行构建几何与刀具路径流程的前沿模型。

papers.title: Regularized Score Centering
papers.abstract: Abstract  Asynchronous reinforcement learning increases training throughput, but data from stale policies and numerical mismatch between training and inference can destabilize learning. To stabilize off-policy learning, score centering (SC) removes the effect of reward baselines on the expected update. Our gradient diagnostics show less extreme gradients with SC than with importance sampling (IS), but SC can still fail when the learner moves far from the behavior policy that generated the data. To limit this policy mismatch, we introduce Regularized Score Centering (RSC), which adds a reverse Kullback-Leibler (KL) penalty to encourage the learner's next-token distribution to stay close to the behavior policy's next-token distribution. RSC works with or without truncated importance sampling (TIS), which caps token importance weights. Our theoretical analysis supports this approach, showing that KL regularization improves convergence guarantees. We evaluate dense and mixture-of-experts models on mathematical reasoning and agentic tasks, including online shopping, tool use, games, and fully asynchronous software engineering. RSC with TIS substantially improves sample efficiency across all agentic benchmarks, attaining higher training rewards with the same number of sampled responses. In final evaluations, it achieves top performance across all six agentic tasks, improving by 14.3% on AppWorld and reaching 9.9 times the strongest baseline's score on BabyAI.

ru.title: Стабильное асинхронное обучение агентов: держим политику рядом с поведением
ru.desc: Статья посвящена асинхронному обучению с подкреплением (RL), которое ускоряет тренировку, но из-за устаревших политик и численного расхождения между обучением и инференсом может стать нестабильным. Авторы предлагают метод Regularized Score Centering (RSC), который дополняет score centering штрафом по обратной KL-дивергенции, удерживая распределение следующего токена близко к поведенческой политике. Метод можно использовать вместе с truncated importance sampling (TIS) или без него, а теоретический анализ показывает улучшение гарантий сходимости. На задачах математического рассуждения и агентных задачах (онлайн-шопинг, использование инструментов, игры, software engineering) RSC с TIS заметно повышает sample efficiency и показывает лучшие результаты, например рост на 14.3% в AppWorld и почти в 10 раз выше лучшего baseline на BabyAI.

en.title: Keep Policies Close, Make Asynchronous Learning Stronger
en.desc: The paper introduces Regularized Score Centering (RSC), a method for stabilizing off-policy reinforcement learning when training data comes from older policies. RSC adds a reverse KL penalty that keeps the learner’s next-token distribution close to the behavior policy’s distribution, reducing policy mismatch. It can be combined with truncated importance sampling, which caps token importance weights, and the analysis shows that KL regularization improves convergence guarantees. Across mathematical reasoning and six agentic tasks, RSC with truncated importance sampling improves sample efficiency and achieves strong final performance, including gains on AppWorld and BabyAI.

zh.title: 用反向 KL 约束策略偏移，让异步强化学习更稳定、更高效
zh.desc: 异步强化学习能提高训练吞吐量，但旧策略产生的数据以及训练与推理之间的数值差异，可能导致学习不稳定。分数中心化（SC）可以减轻奖励基线的影响，但当当前策略偏离生成数据的行为策略较远时仍可能失效。本文提出正则化分数中心化（RSC），通过加入反向 KL 散度惩罚，使学习器的下一词元分布保持接近行为策略；它可与截断重要性采样（TIS）搭配使用，也可单独使用。理论分析表明 KL 正则化有助于改善收敛保证，实验则显示 RSC 与 TIS 在多种智能体任务上提升了样本效率，并在六项任务的最终评测中取得领先表现。

papers.title: AuXSpec: Learning to Autoformalize Program Specifications via Executable Postconditions
papers.abstract: Abstract  Formal specifications define intended program behavior and underpin verification, but writing them in theorem provers such as Lean is slow and expertise-intensive, making specification a major bottleneck to scaling formally correct code. Autoformalization from natural-language problems is promising, yet training specification models requires scalable feedback on whether generated specifications capture intended behavior. Prior approaches obtain this feedback through explicit proofs or separately implemented code with formal correspondence proofs, both expensive. We introduce AuXSpec, a Lean framework that pairs declarative postconditions with executable counterparts, obtained through type class resolution when possible and otherwise defined separately with an equivalence proof. Test cases can then evaluate declarative specifications by execution, letting us use agreement as a reinforcement-learning reward. Using AuXSpec, we synthesize 3,037 LeetCode problems and expand training to 19.5K samples through expert iteration on Codeforces. Experiments show that training Qwen3.5-9B and Qwen3.8-27B with the execution-based reward improves SpecGen pass@4 on AuXSpec-Test 0.7% to 82.7% and 14.3% to 84.3%, and the 27B model outperforms all frontier models. On the out-of-domain Verina benchmark with its original prompts, both models improve 7.0% to 90.5% and 21.9% to 90.5% and surpass VeriSpecGen-30B-A3B, the prior state of the art among open-source specification models, on pass@1 (theirs 47.6% vs. ours 73.7% and 84.5%) and pass@4 (theirs 63.9% at pass@10 vs. ours 90.5%). We release the weights of the trained 9B and 27B models and the 3,037 problems with test cases, including the 300-problem AuXSpec-Test benchmark with expert review and correctness proofs for future evaluation. Models and data: https://huggingface.co/collections/eth-algopt/auxspec. Website: https://auxspec.org
affiliations: Institute for Theoretical Studies, ETH Zurich

ru.title: Исполнение вместо доказательств: обучаем LLM писать формальные спецификации через RL
ru.desc: Статья представляет AuXSpec — фреймворк на Lean, который связывает декларативные постусловия с исполняемыми аналогами, чтобы не требовать дорогих формальных доказательств. Тесты для таких спецификаций вычисляются исполнением, и согласованность с тестами используется как reward в reinforcement learning. С помощью этого подхода создаются большие датасеты задач и обучаются модели Qwen3.5-9B и Qwen3.8-27B для генерации спецификаций. Модели заметно улучшают результаты на AuXSpec-Test и Verina и превосходят прежний open-source SOTA VeriSpecGen-30B-A3B.

en.title: Test specifications by running them, and train models to write them better
en.desc: AuXSpec makes it easier to train AI models to write formal specifications in Lean, which describe what programs should do. It pairs each declarative specification with an executable version, so test cases can check whether the specification behaves as intended. The researchers use agreement with these tests as a reinforcement-learning reward and train models on thousands of programming problems. Their trained models perform much better on specification benchmarks, including problems outside their training data, than earlier models.

zh.title: 让测试反馈驱动 Lean 规格生成
zh.desc: 论文提出 AuXSpec，这是一个用于 Lean 的框架，将声明式后置条件与可执行版本配对，并在必要时证明两者等价。这样就能用测试运行声明式规格，并将测试结果的一致性作为强化学习奖励，减少依赖人工证明或另写验证代码的成本。研究者据此构建了数千道题目，并训练规格生成模型；实验显示，这种训练显著提升了模型在多个基准上的表现，也超过了此前的开源方法。作者还发布了训练后的模型、题目数据和经过专家审查的评测集。

papers.title: M3OPD-Reasoner: An Open Recipe for Post-Training Multimodal Reasoning with Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract: Abstract  Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation (MOPD) enables a single student to absorb the skills of several domain teachers by learning from its own generated responses. We present Multimodal Model Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation Reasoner (M3OPD-Reasoner), a fully open recipe for post-training vision-language models (VLMs) over three reasoning domains: image STEM, image perception, and video. We curate two datasets, M3OPD-SFT-1.35M for supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and M3OPD-RL-193K for reinforcement learning (RL) with verifiable rewards. On these data, we compare post-training recipes that start from Qwen3.5-9B: training one model on the mixed data of all domains (MixSFT and MixRL), and training one teacher per domain with Group Sequence Policy Optimization (GSPO), directly or after an SFT warm-up, and distilling the teachers into one student with MOPD. We evaluate on 21 image STEM, image perception, and video reasoning benchmarks after we decontaminate the training data against them. The comparison establishes MOPD of teachers trained with GSPO directly from Qwen3.5-9B as the best recipe: the student closely matches each teacher on its own domain and is on average above the mixed-training baselines on the same prompts. Since MOPD already merges the domain capabilities that MixRL would otherwise have to learn, its student is a stronger starting point for RL, and we ask whether the same data can carry the model further from there: we add MixRL on top of the MOPD student, on the same prompts and with the same settings, which, to our knowledge, no prior VLM recipe has studied. The same prompts still improve the MOPD student, with no collapse, and give our main model, M3OPD-Reasoner-9B. MOPD and MixRL can therefore work as consecutive stages that get more out of the same data. We release all data, the training code, and the checkpoints of every stage.

ru.title: Сначала учитель-эксперт, потом общий ученик: дистилляция для мультимодального рассуждения
ru.desc: Статья предлагает открытый рецепт пост-обучения визуально-языковых моделей (VLM) в трёх областях: STEM по изображениям, восприятие изображений и видео. Авторы сравнивают обучение одной модели на смешанных данных с подходом, где для каждой области обучают отдельного учителя с помощью GSPO, а затем дистиллируют их в одного ученика методом Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation (MOPD). Лучшим оказался MOPD с учителями, обученными GSPO напрямую из Qwen3.5-9B: ученик близок к каждому учителю в своей области и в среднем превосходит смешанное обучение. Затем на студента добавляют обучение с подкреплением MixRL с верифицируемыми наградами, что даёт итоговую модель M3OPD-Reasoner-9B без коллапса, а все данные, код и чекпоинты выложены в открытый доступ.

en.title: Many expert teachers, one stronger vision-language reasoner
en.desc: This paper introduces M3OPD-Reasoner, an open method for training vision-language models to reason about images and videos. It trains specialist teacher models for different domains, then uses multi-teacher on-policy distillation to teach their skills to one student from the student’s own responses. Across 21 benchmarks, this student performs better on average than models trained on mixed data, while closely matching each specialist in its domain. Further reinforcement learning on the same data improves the student without harming its existing abilities, showing that distillation and reinforcement learning can be effective consecutive stages.

zh.title: 多教师蒸馏融合专长，再用强化学习持续提升
zh.desc: 本文提出 M3OPD-Reasoner，一套开放的视觉语言模型后训练方法，让一个学生模型从多个领域教师的回答中学习。研究团队整理了用于监督微调和带可验证奖励强化学习的数据，覆盖图像 STEM、图像感知和视频推理。实验表明，先用 GSPO 训练各领域教师，再通过多教师在线策略蒸馏合并能力，效果优于直接混合训练；之后继续进行混合强化学习，还能在相同数据上进一步提升，且没有出现能力崩塌。团队公开了数据、训练代码和各阶段模型检查点，供后续研究使用。

papers.title: The novelty exposed: ablation, reproducibility and transparency in 40 technical reports of open-weight large language models (LLMs)
papers.abstract: Abstract  In 2025 alone, 48 new large language model (LLM) architectures were added to the Hugging Face transformers library, and many of them arrive with a technical report that presents the model as new. What is actually new in these models, and is it tested? We put this question to LLM technical reports. We look at three things: what the reference code shows about how new open-weight architectures differ from earlier ones; what 40 randomly sampled technical reports claim as new and whether they support it with ablation studies; and what they disclose for reproducibility and transparency. In the library, 39 of the 48 architectures added in 2025 take at least two of their three core blocks from another model, most often Llama, although part of this reflects how the library writes code. In the reports, 19 of 73 architectural or training novelty claims come with a controlled with/without comparison; 4 of 40 reports state more than one training run; 8 rerun the models they compare against under one setup; and 1 discloses data mixture, token count, and compute together. We also looked for known components given new names: none of five candidate cases hid its origin, though we did not study model names. We propose seven reporting rules for LLM release reports and apply them to two reports. We do not judge model quality, and an untested claim may still be true.

ru.title: Новое в LLM — не всегда проверено и не всегда ново
ru.desc: Авторы изучают, что на самом деле нового в LLM-архитектурах, добавленных в библиотеку Hugging Face transformers в 2025 году. Они анализируют код, а также 40 случайно выбранных технических отчётов, проверяя, подтверждают ли заявленные новшества ablation-экспериментами. Выяснилось, что большинство архитектур заимствуют основные блоки у других моделей, чаще всего у Llama, а контролируемые сравнения и раскрытие данных для воспроизводимости встречаются редко. В работе предложены семь правил отчётности для релизов LLM, которые применяются к двум отчётам, при этом качество моделей не оценивается.

en.title: Make LLM Novelty Claims Testable
en.desc: This study examines what is genuinely new in recent open-weight LLM architectures and how well technical reports test and document their claims. It finds that many architectures reuse core blocks from earlier models, while only 19 of 73 novelty claims are supported by controlled ablation studies. Reports also rarely describe multiple training runs, rerun comparison models under the same setup, or disclose data, token, and compute details together. The authors propose seven reporting rules to improve transparency and reproducibility, while noting that untested claims are not necessarily false.

zh.title: 让大模型创新经得起验证
zh.desc: 本文分析大语言模型技术报告，探讨新发布的模型架构究竟有何创新，以及这些创新是否经过检验。研究发现，48 个新架构中有 39 个至少三个核心模块中的两个沿用了其他模型的设计，通常来自 Llama；在 73 项架构或训练创新主张中，只有 19 项提供了有无该设计的对照消融实验。报告对可复现性和透明度的披露也较少，例如只有 4 份报告说明进行了多次训练，只有 1 份同时披露数据组成、词元数量和计算资源。作者据此提出七项技术报告规范，但强调本文不评判模型质量，未经测试的创新主张也不一定是错误的。

papers.title: WeightBench: Evaluating Language Models as Weight-Space Programmers
papers.abstract: Abstract The WEIGHTBENCH benchmark evaluates the capacity of large language models to perform Weight-Space Programming tasks, which involve reading, modifying, and generating the weights of various neural network architectures.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Recent work shows that large language models (LLMs) can operate directly on the parameters of other neural networks. They can read what a network was trained to do, fix a network that fails, and write working networks from scratch, all without gradient descent. This capability has been termed Weight-Space Programming (WSP). Exploring this new paradigm systematically requires a robust benchmark. We introduce WEIGHTBENCH, a benchmark that evaluates LLMs of increasing capability on 42 WSP tasks across five tracks: reading, fixing and writing weights, recognizing edits that are impossible, and data-free compression. The networks whose weights the LLMs read and edit range from 2K-parameter control policies to 7B-parameter language models. Experimental benchmark results show that frontier agents can already read small networks and write working control policies without ever running them, but cannot yet patch language models, compress them without data, or tell an impossible edit from a hard one. On all 42 tasks, Claude Opus 5.5 reaches a macro score of 0.535 (Sonnet 5.5 0.466, Haiku 5.5 0.402, DeepSeek v4-flash 0.215); on the 38 tasks it was run on, GPT-6.1-sol reaches 0.568 against Opus's 0.546. Code, the task registry, our OS-level sandbox harness, and the live leaderboard are publicly available at https://github.com/Aayush-Marasini/WeightBench.

ru.title: LLM учатся программировать веса нейросетей, но пока не всё умеют
ru.desc: Статья представляет WEIGHTBENCH — бенчмарк из 42 задач для оценки того, насколько large language models (LLM) умеют работать напрямую с весами других нейронных сетей, то есть читать, исправлять и генерировать их без градиентного спуска. Задачи охватывают пять направлений: чтение, исправление и написание весов, распознавание невозможных правок и сжатие без данных, а размер сетей варьируется от 2K до 7B параметров. Результаты показывают, что frontier AI-агенты уже справляются с чтением малых сетей и написанием рабочих control policies, но пока не могут эффективно патчить языковые модели, сжимать их без данных или отличать невозможную правку от трудной. Лучший результат по macro score достигает Claude Opus 5.5 (0.535), а код и живой leaderboard опубликованы в открытом доступе.

en.title: Testing How Well AI Can Program Neural Network Weights
en.desc: WEIGHTBENCH is a benchmark for testing whether large language models can directly read, edit, and generate neural network weights, a capability called Weight-Space Programming (WSP). It measures performance on 42 tasks across five tracks, including interpreting networks, repairing or writing weights, detecting impossible edits, and compressing models without data. The tested networks range from small control policies to language models with billions of parameters, and the benchmark does not require gradient descent for these tasks. Results show that leading models can handle some small networks but still struggle to repair language models, compress them without data, and distinguish impossible edits from difficult ones.

zh.title: 用 WEIGHTBENCH 衡量大模型直接编程神经网络权重的能力
zh.desc: 本文提出 WEIGHTBENCH，用来评估大语言模型直接读写神经网络权重的能力，这种能力称为权重空间编程（WSP）。基准包含 42 项任务，涵盖读取、修复和编写权重、识别不可能的修改，以及无数据压缩，测试对象从小型控制策略到大型语言模型。实验显示，先进模型已能读取小型网络，并在不运行网络的情况下编写可用的控制策略，但仍难以修补语言模型、无数据压缩模型，或判断某项修改是否不可能。研究团队公开了代码、任务集、沙箱测试框架和排行榜，以支持对 WSP 能力的系统评测。

papers.title: Unreasonable Confidence from Simulator Misspecification: Directional Robustness on the SPEED+ Sim-to-Real Benchmark
papers.abstract: Abstract A simple monocular pose estimator trained on synthetic spacecraft images shows poor real-world transfer, with overconfident pose errors and uneven gains from backbone adaptation and photometric augmentation under different lighting.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Vision-based navigation systems for orbit must be trained almost entirely on synthetic imagery, because real labelled images of a given spacecraft in flight rarely exist. Benchmarks like SPEED+ are built for that situation: the training set comes from a simulator, and the test sets are real images of a satellite mockup under two kinds of lighting. That simulator approximates how light reflects off mylar and aluminium, and like every scientific simulator it is misspecified. Its error is radiometric, since it misses the specular highlights, hard shadows and sensor saturation common in real images. We probe the resulting synthetic-to-real gap, the central risk for such systems, with a deliberately simple monocular pose estimator. In a 2x2 study of backbone adaptation and photometric augmentation, trained on synthetic images and tested on both real hardware-in-the-loop domains, we find three things. (1) The model does not know it is failing: regions conformally calibrated to 90% on synthetic data cover only 9-15% of rotation errors on sunlamp and 21-38% on lightbox, so a wrong pose carries the confidence of a correct one. (2) Transfer is asymmetric: scaling data and features improved synthetic rotation error from 1.65 to 1.03 rad but moved the harshly lit sunlamp domain by only 0.05 rad, under twice its seed s.d., whereas adapting the backbone's last stage carried 63-83% of its extra synthetic gain to both real domains. (3) Once the backbone adapts, augmentation helps only in the direction it models: our photometric stack improved the diffusely lit lightbox domain from 1.17 to 0.99 rad on every seed but moved sunlamp no more than seed-to-seed variation, while with the backbone frozen it helped sunlamp more. Every post-review experiment was pre-registered, and the code, per-image predictions and pre-registration record are at https://github.com/lokindoo/spacecraft-pose-estimation.

ru.title: Модель уверена в ошибках: синтетика не заменит реальность
ru.desc: Статья исследует, как монокулярная модель оценки позы космического аппарата, обученная на синтетических изображениях, переносится на реальные снимки, и показывает существенный разрыв между синтетической и реальной областями. Модель оказывается чрезмерно уверенной: доверительные области, калиброванные на синтетике, покрывают лишь малую долю ошибок на реальных данных. Адаптация последнего этапа backbone-сети переносит большую часть выигрыша на реальные домены, тогда как масштабирование данных и признаков почти не помогает при жёстком освещении. Фотометрическая аугментация работает только в том направлении освещения, которое она моделирует, что подтверждено в предрегистрированном 2x2-исследовании.

en.title: Train for the Simulated World, Adapt for the Real One
en.desc: This paper studies how well a spacecraft pose estimator trained on synthetic images works on real images with different lighting. Its confidence estimates are unreliable: predictions can be very wrong even when the model reports high confidence. Adapting the backbone’s final stage transfers more of its improvement to real images than simply scaling up the model and training data. Photometric augmentation helps under diffuse lighting after backbone adaptation, but does not reliably help under harsh lighting.

zh.title: 从合成到真实：适配骨干网络，让航天器姿态估计更可靠
zh.desc: 这项研究探讨只用合成图像训练的单目航天器姿态估计器，为什么难以迁移到真实图像。模型在合成数据上经过90%覆盖率校准后，真实测试中的旋转误差覆盖率却很低，说明它面对错误姿态时仍可能给出很高的置信度。扩大数据和特征规模能显著降低合成数据误差，却几乎没有改善强烈日照下的真实图像；相比之下，微调骨干网络最后一阶段能将大部分合成数据上的额外收益带到真实场景。光度增强的效果取决于光照类型和骨干网络是否经过适配：它能改善漫射光场景，但对强烈日照场景的帮助有限。

papers.title: GameRealm: Grounding Visual Learning in Interactive Games
papers.abstract: Abstract GameRealm is a large-scale multimodal gameplay dataset with synchronized depth, camera, audio, control, and 3D trajectory annotations that improves visual foundation models for generation and geometric learning.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Visual foundation models are central to physical intelligence, yet their development remains constrained by fragmented training datasets, inconsistent annotation quality, and limited multimodal supervision. To address these challenges, we introduce GameRealm, a large-scale, richly annotated dataset that grounds visual observations in synchronized, game-native supervision. GameRealm encompasses over 120 million RGB frames and 1,000 hours of gameplay footage across all views. Beyond its unprecedented scale, GameRealm provides rich multimodal supervision, including metric depth, camera parameters, synchronized audio, control inputs, and 3D point trajectories. Its diversity further extends to flexible view configurations, spanning single-view, stereo, multi-view, and panoramic recordings. To enable scalable acquisition across diverse game environments, we develop a unified data collection pipeline that combines human-operated interaction with agentic exploration. Extensive experiments across diverse visual learning tasks demonstrate that GameRealm consistently strengthens visual foundation models in both visual generation and geometric learning. These results establish GameRealm as a versatile and valuable data resource, unlocking new opportunities for advancing visual intelligence.

ru.title: Игры как обучающий полигон для визуального интеллекта
ru.desc: Авторы представляют GameRealm — большой мультимодальный датасет из более чем 120 миллионов RGB-кадров и 1000 часов игрового видео с синхронизированной разметкой. Помимо изображений, датасет содержит метрическую глубину, параметры камеры, аудио, управляющие входы и 3D-траектории точек, а также поддерживает разные конфигурации камер: одиночные, стерео, мультивидовые и панорамные. Данные собираются единым пайплайном, который сочетает действия живых игроков и агентное исследование игрового мира. Эксперименты показывают, что такие данные улучшают visual foundation models как в задачах генерации, так и в геометрическом обучении.

en.title: Ground Gameplay in Rich Multimodal Data
en.desc: GameRealm is a large-scale gameplay dataset designed to improve visual foundation models. It contains over 120 million RGB frames and 1,000 hours of footage, with synchronized depth, camera, audio, control, and 3D trajectory annotations. Its data covers different viewpoints and is collected using both human interaction and agent exploration. Experiments show that training with GameRealm improves performance in visual generation and geometric learning.

zh.title: 让游戏数据为视觉智能打下坚实基础
zh.desc: GameRealm 是一个大规模游戏数据集，包含超过 1.2 亿张 RGB 画面和 1,000 小时的游戏视频。数据集为画面配有同步的深度、相机参数、音频、控制输入和三维轨迹等标注，也涵盖单视角、立体、多视角和全景视图。研究团队结合人工操作与智能体探索，设计了统一的数据采集流程，以收集不同游戏环境中的数据。实验表明，使用 GameRealm 训练能够提升视觉基础模型在视觉生成和几何学习任务上的表现。

papers.title: PanDWM: Panoramic 4D Driving World Models
papers.abstract: Abstract PanDWM stitches six camera views into a 360° panoramic band and uses a distilled causal student with a feed-forward 3D Gaussian decoder to generate consistent 4D driving scenes faster and with better FID/FVD than multi-camera baselines.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Driving world models usually generate videos from six pinhole cameras with separate optical centres and small overlaps, and must learn to keep these views consistent. We present PanDWM, which stitches them into one 360^circ panoramic band. Camera boundaries then fall inside one image, so keeping the views consistent means keeping the image continuous, and each pixel still records its camera ray. Conditioned on layouts, a causal student generates the band window by window in four steps; it is distilled from a causal teacher and trained on its own rollouts. A feed-forward decoder lifts each frame along these rays into 3D Gaussians, and static Gaussians from neighbouring frames complete them into 4D scenes. On nuScenes, scored in one stitched 360^circ view, PanDWM has lower FID and FVD than the multi-camera baselines at 8-46times their speed, and keeps its 50-step teacher's FID while lowering FVD by 22-25%.

ru.title: Одна панорама вместо шести камер: быстрый и согласованный 4D-мир для автономного вождения
ru.desc: Авторы представляют PanDWM — driving world model, которая склеивает шесть камер автомобиля в единую 360°-панораму, так что границы между видами оказываются внутри одного изображения и согласованность достигается за счёт непрерывности картинки. Каузальный student-генератор, дистиллированный из каузального teacher и обученный на собственных rollout-ах, создаёт панораму окно за окном всего за четыре шага денойзинга. Feed-forward декодер переводит кадры в 3D Gaussians, а статичные гауссианы соседних кадров дополняют их до 4D-сцены. На nuScenes модель получает меньшие FID и FVD, чем мульти-камерные baseline-ы, работая в 8–46 раз быстрее при сохранении качества teacher-а.

en.title: One panoramic view for faster, more consistent driving worlds
en.desc: PanDWM combines six driving-camera views into one 360° panoramic image, making cross-camera consistency easier to maintain. Given scene layouts, a causal student generates the panorama in windows using four steps; it is distilled from a causal teacher and trained on its own generated outputs. A feed-forward 3D Gaussian decoder uses the camera rays in each pixel to lift frames into 3D, then combines information across frames to form 4D scenes. On nuScenes, PanDWM achieves lower FID and FVD than multi-camera baselines while running 8–46 times faster, and it matches its teacher’s FID while reducing FVD by 22–25%.

zh.title: 拼接 360° 全景，让驾驶世界生成更快、更连贯
zh.desc: PanDWM 将六个摄像头的画面拼接成一条 360° 全景图带，让原本分开的视角变成一张连续图像，从而更容易保持画面一致。它根据场景布局，以因果方式逐段生成全景画面，并通过知识蒸馏和自身生成结果训练，使生成过程只需四步。接着，前馈式 3D 高斯解码器沿着每个像素对应的摄像机射线，把画面转换为 3D 高斯表示，再结合相邻帧中的静态高斯构建 4D 驾驶场景。在 nuScenes 数据集上，PanDWM 的 FID 和 FVD 优于多摄像头基线，速度快 8 至 46 倍；与 50 步教师模型相比，它保持了相近的 FID，并将 FVD 降低 22% 至 25%。

papers.title: TPHC: Improving Hyper-Connections with Tensor-Parallel Grouped Updates
papers.abstract: Abstract TPHC combines tensor-parallel shards with hyper-connection residual streams to enable more independent stream updates, improving language model loss and zero-shot reasoning with modest training overhead.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Hyper-Connections (HC) expand the residual stream of a Transformer into N parallel streams, and manifold-constrained HC (mHC) stabilizes them at scale. However, mHC benefits little from more than four streams, partly because each sublayer writes a single output to all streams, limiting how differently they can be updated. In this work, we propose TPHC, which integrates tensor-parallel (TP) shards with HC streams to promote greater independence across streams. Specifically, we route a separate mixture of the residual streams to each TP shard and keep the individual shard outputs separate during write-back, so each stream can receive a different mixture of those outputs. This design makes the residual-stream updates more expressive without adding parameters or FLOPs to the attention or FFN sublayers. With native support for stream sharding under TP, TPHC requires only 9% more training time than mHC on an 8B model when both use four streams. Increasing the number of streams from four to sixteen raises its training time by only 19%. On a 1.1B model trained on 100B tokens, TPHC reduces validation loss by 0.7-1.0% and raises average zero-shot accuracy across six commonsense reasoning benchmarks by 0.3-0.7 percentage points relative to mHC at matched stream counts Nin{4,8,16}. Our code is available at https://github.com/wuyou2002/TPHC.

ru.title: Независимые потоки — выразительнее остаточная связь LLM
ru.desc: В статье предлагается метод TPHC, который объединяет тензорный параллелизм (tensor-parallel shards) с гипер-связями (Hyper-Connections) в остаточном потоке Transformer. Каждый шард получает собственную смесь остаточных потоков, а выходы шардов не суммируются, а записываются раздельно, что делает обновления потоков более независимыми и выразительными. Такой подход не добавляет параметров и FLOPs в слои внимания и FFN, а накладные расходы на обучение составляют всего 9% по сравнению с mHC на 8B модели. На модели 1.1B по эксперименту TPHC снижает validation loss на 0.7–1.0% и повышает точность zero-shot на шести бенчмарках на здравый смысл на 0.3–0.7 п.п. относительно mHC при одинаковом числе потоков.

en.title: More Independent Streams, Better Language Models
en.desc: TPHC combines tensor-parallel shards with multiple residual streams in a Transformer. Each shard reads a different mixture of streams and keeps its output separate, allowing streams to receive more varied updates than in manifold-constrained hyper-connections (mHC). This makes residual updates more expressive without adding parameters or computation to the attention or feed-forward layers, and training overhead remains modest. In experiments, TPHC reduces validation loss and improves zero-shot accuracy on commonsense reasoning tasks compared with mHC at the same number of streams.

zh.title: 让残差流各自更新，提升模型表现而不显著增加训练开销
zh.desc: TPHC 将张量并行（TP）的分片与超连接（HC）的残差流结合，让不同残差流能更独立地更新。它为每个 TP 分片分别混合残差流，并在写回时保留各分片的独立输出，使每条流可以接收不同的输出组合。该方法不增加注意力层或前馈网络（FFN）的参数量与计算量；在实验中，它以适度的训练开销降低了验证损失，并提升了常识推理基准上的零样本准确率。与 mHC 相比，TPHC 在使用 4、8 或 16 条流时都取得了这些提升，且将流数从 4 增至 16 只让训练时间增加约 19%。

papers.title: Glyph: An Interpretability Engine for AI-Driven Scientific Discovery in Clinical Data
papers.abstract: Abstract Glyph uses foundation models and sparse autoencoders to extract interpretable clinical concepts from multimodal records and CT data, revealing reproducible predictive associations across patient cohorts.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Automated scientific discovery has the potential to advance understanding of disease mechanisms and accelerate identification of early disease markers. Manual data annotation is infeasible at population scale, motivating methods that automatically extract pre-defined phenotypes in multimodal and unstructured clinical data. Such pre-defined feature sets determine and limit which associations these approaches can discover. This limitation extends to agentic AI systems that use these tools to query population-scale data. In contrast, foundation models (FMs) trained on large volumes of clinical data can perform tasks beyond their training objectives. This suggests their latent embeddings may represent novel or unexplored features that could yield insights into disease mechanisms, yet such latent features remain difficult to interpret. To address this challenge, we introduce Glyph, an automated multistage framework that extracts features from multimodal and unstructured clinical data using FMs and sparse autoencoders, interprets them as coded clinical concepts, and evaluates their value for clinical scientific discovery. We applied Glyph to abdominal CT volumes, CT radiology reports and laboratory measurements from 41,628 patients across different institutions. We identified 397 predictive concepts supported by 4,463 Bonferroni-significant associations. Moreover, a majority of discovered associations were automatically reproducible in held-out cohorts across different sites. Glyph concepts provided complementary associations to literature-derived markers, leading to gains in predictive power. We envision that interpretability can extend beyond a mechanistic understanding of neural networks to connecting implicitly learned features with clinical knowledge and establishing their significance for patient outcomes. We release Glyph at https://github.com/StanfordMIMI/Glyph.

ru.title: Интерпретируемые клинические признаки из скрытых представлений нейросети открывают новые связи с исходами пациентов
ru.desc: Статья описывает Glyph — автоматизированный фреймворк, который использует foundation models и sparse autoencoders для извлечения признаков из мультимодальных клинических данных, включая КТ-снимки брюшной полости, радиологические отчёты и лабораторные показатели. Латентные признаки интерпретируются как закодированные клинические концепты, после чего оцениваются их предсказательная сила и связи с исходами пациентов. На данных 41 628 пациентов выявлено 397 предсказательных концептов и 4 463 статистически значимые ассоциации, большинство из которых воспроизводятся на независимых выборках из других центров. Концепты Glyph дают дополняющую информацию к маркерам из литературы и повышают точность предсказаний.

en.title: Turn hidden clinical patterns into discoveries
en.desc: Glyph is a framework that uses foundation models and sparse autoencoders to find interpretable clinical concepts in CT scans, radiology reports, and lab results. It maps these learned features to coded clinical concepts, helping researchers discover patterns beyond predefined markers. Tested on records from 41,628 patients, Glyph found 397 predictive concepts linked to thousands of statistically significant associations. Most associations reproduced across independent hospital cohorts, and the concepts improved prediction when combined with known clinical markers.

zh.title: 让基础模型的潜在特征成为可解释、可复现的临床发现
zh.desc: 本文提出 Glyph，一种利用基础模型和稀疏自编码器从多模态、非结构化临床数据中自动提取特征的框架。它将模型学到的潜在特征解释为临床概念，并评估这些概念与患者结局之间的关联。研究分析了来自多家机构的 41,628 名患者的腹部 CT、放射学报告和实验室数据，发现 397 个具有预测价值的概念及 4,463 个通过 Bonferroni 校正显著的关联。许多关联能在不同机构的留出队列中复现，且这些概念与文献中的标志物互为补充，提升了预测能力。
